message: `begin_keywords "{spec}": unknown version specifier; the LRM (10.6) defines "VAMS-2.3", "1364-2005", "1364-2001" and "1364-1995"
description: The version named by `` `begin_keywords `` is not one the language standard defines, so the set of reserved words to use is unknown.
actions: Use one of the versions listed in the message, spelled exactly.
